speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Dick has the forty leaves. He put them under his arm and he did not ask. I am not walking back to Holywell for them tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Send it whole. George said the cutting is the Master's, and the room agreed. John wants it shown where this week is written down as a week we may. It is not written.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The streets were swept. The gate looked at every face. The almanac said no play. The afternoon was struck before we sat. I have not put a name to that bill, and I am not going to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Kemp came at the end and wanted a door. Another day. Not this book, not this night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The horn is filled, and that was twopence. The king can wait. Enough.
